tagline: An exclusive Bosphorus bay where foreign embassies have summer residences — serene, beautiful, and one of the most scenic spots on the upper European shore.

items.name: Tarabya İskelesi Çay Bahçesi
items.description: A pleasant tea garden by the Tarabya ferry landing with views across the bay. Locals stop here for tea between errands — proper neighbourhood feeling.

items.name: Tarabya Balık Restoranları
items.description: A row of excellent fish restaurants around the Tarabya bay and marina. One of the most scenic dining settings on the Bosphorus.
items.tip: Reserve a waterfront table in advance. The bay views at sunset are exceptional — arrive early to see the light change.

items.name: Tarabya Koyu (Bay)
items.description: A sheltered, perfectly curved bay with moored yachts, a tree-lined waterfront, and an almost Mediterranean atmosphere. Walk the full perimeter.

items.name: Embassy Summer Residences Walk
items.description: The hills above Tarabya are lined with the historic summer residences of foreign embassies — grand 19th-century villas in leafy gardens. A fascinating architectural walk.

tips: Tarabya is on the Bosphorus bus route from Beşiktaş or Sarıyer metro — about 40 minutes from the city centre.
A quieter and more exclusive alternative to the busier Bosphorus villages further south.
Best combined with Yeniköy (just south) for a pleasant coastal afternoon.
Avoid driving on summer weekends — the coastal road backs up significantly.
